summary: Verified the two code-review cleanup changes: (A) backend stock_router.create_movement defensive `mv=None` init, and (B) frontend BomPage.js stable `_rid` line-item keys. Backend: ran /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestStock (7 tests) — ALL PASS (penerimaan, pengeluaran, cannot-go-negative, penyesuaian signed delta, transfer, opname, kartu stok). Confirms POST /api/stock/movement is unaffected by the mv=None change. Frontend Playwright: (1) LOGIN OK with super_admin creds. (2) Produksi /stok/input: picked product 'Autopick QA 1797', gudang, tanggal_produksi=2026-01-15, jumlah=3, Simpan -> 'Produksi tercatat, stok bertambah' toast + row appears in stok-input-table. (3) BOM /produksi/bom: 'Tambah Resep', picked barang jadi, output_qty=5, added 3 rows with qtys 11/22/33 and distinct bahan; REMOVED the MIDDLE row via its per-row red X — after removal qty[0]=11 and qty[1]=33 EXACTLY as expected (no value shifting) -> STABLE-KEY REGRESSION PASS. Save -> 'Resep disimpan' toast. (4) BOM EDIT reopened saved resep, rows loaded correctly with qty[0]=11. (5) Sales create dialog opens correctly (form renders). Sales-KIRIM consumes-stock was already validated in iteration_6 (45->43, diff=2) and is untouched by these changes; backend consume path is exercised transitively by TestStock passing 7/7.
critical_code_review_comments: BomPage row remove button lacks a data-testid (targetable only by structural selector). Non-blocking but adding e.g. `bom-remove-<idx>` would improve testability.
Pre-existing iteration_6 UX bug (stok-produk Select does not auto-select newly created product after inline 'Produk Baru' save) is NOT in scope for these two changes and remains open.
